series.name: MPPT Plus Hybrid charge controller (text messages)
series.notes: Official MPPT manuals use full-word LCD WARNING/ERROR strings, not 2-digit codes.

meaning.en: PV panel voltage is too low (not detected as valid array).
meaning.ur: PV voltage bohat kam (are nahin mila)

causes.en: Array Voc < ~1.5x battery V, open DC breaker, bad string
causes.ur: Array Voc battery voltage se kam, DC breaker khula, ya string kharab.

causes.en: DC breaker or isolator left open.
causes.ur: DC breaker ya isolator khula hua hai.

causes.en: Loose or corroded DC connector between array and charger.
causes.ur: Array aur charger ke darmiyan DC connector dheela ya zang ya hai.

solutions.en: Turn off the PV DC isolator, then measure the array open-circuit voltage with a meter — it must be more than 1.5 times the battery voltage.
solutions.ur: PV DC isolator band karein, phir meter se array ka open-circuit voltage naapein — woh battery voltage se 1.5 guna zyada hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Check the DC breaker is closed and the connectors between array and charger are tight and clean.
solutions.ur: DC breaker band hai ya nahin, aur array se charger ke darmiyan connectors tight aur saaf hain — yeh check karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the string for a bad panel or broken cable, replace what is faulty and retest.
solutions.ur: String mein kharab panel ya tooti hui cable check karein, jo kharab ho use badal kar dobara test karein.

meaning.en: Manual maps FAN FAULT message to temperature sensor faulty.
meaning.ur: Manual ke mutabiq FAN FAULT message ka matlab hai temperature sensor kharab.

causes.en: Fan connector loose or fan supply wire broken.
causes.ur: Fan ka connection dheela ya supply wire tooti hui hai.

causes.en: Fan blocked by dust or bearing seized.
causes.ur: Fan dhool se roka hua hai ya bearing phans gaya hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch and wait 5 minutes before opening the unit; check the fan for dust, blocked blades or a seized bearing.
solutions.ur: DC switch band kar ke 5 minute ruk kar unit kholein; pankha par dhool, ruki hui blades ya phansi hui bearing check karein.

solutions.en: With power isolated, spin the fan by hand and check its connector on the board.
solutions.ur: Power band kar ke pankha haath se ghuma kar dekhein aur board par us ka connector check karein.

solutions.en: If the fan or the temperature sensor has failed, send the device to the service centre for repair.
solutions.ur: Agar pankha ya temperature sensor kharab ho, to device ko repair ke liye service centre bhej dein.

notes.en: Description text says temperature sensor faulty (not only fan).
notes.ur: Description text ke mutabiq temperature sensor kharab hai (sirf pankha nahi).

causes.en: Direct sun, poor ventilation, ambient high

solutions.en: Shade and airy install location; do not expose unit to strong sunlight; if remains contact manufacturer
solutions.ur: Shaded aur hawa wali jagah intezam karein; unit ko tez dhoop se na bachayein; masla hal na ho to manufacturer se rabta karein.

notes.en: Also in MPPT-User-Manual.pdf and MPPT-USER-MANUAL.Pdf.pdf. Numeric warning stored W-prefixed to avoid collision with same-number fault in this series file.
notes.ur: Yeh MPPT-User-Manual.pdf aur MPPT-USER-MANUAL.Pdf.pdf mein bhi hai. Yeh numeric warning W-prefix ke sath store ki gayi hai taake isi file mein same number ke fault se takraw na ho.

causes.en: Loose MPPT-battery connection, wrong full-charge setpoint, cell fault
Charger full-charge voltage set higher than the battery specification.
causes.ur: Charger ka full-charge voltage battery specification se zyada set hai.

causes.en: Battery cell internally shorted or weak, so voltage keeps rising.
causes.ur: Battery ka cell andar se short ya kamzor hai, is liye voltage barhta rehta hai.

solutions.en: Turn off the DC switch first and check the battery connections for loose joints — this is what the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Pehle DC switch band karein aur battery ke connections check karein ke dheele to nahin — manual pehle yahi instruction deta hai.

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage with a meter and compare it with the full-charge specification; check the charger setting if it is high.
solutions.ur: Meter se battery voltage naapein aur full-charge specification se compare karein; zyada ho to charger setting check karein.

solutions.en: If the voltage stays too high with correct settings, a battery cell may be faulty — contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Sahi settings ke baad bhi voltage zyada rahe, to battery cell kharab ho sakta hai — manufacturer se rabta karein.

notes.en: Numeric warning stored W-prefixed to avoid collision with same-number fault in this series file.
notes.ur: Yeh numeric warning W-prefix ke sath store ki gayi hai taake isi file mein same number ke fault se takraw na ho.

meaning.en: PV panel voltage exceeded device rated maximum input voltage.
meaning.ur: PV panel voltage device ki rated maximum had se upar

causes.en: Too many panels in series / wrong Voc
String extended with extra panels after a change.
causes.ur: Badal ke baad string mein aur panels jod diye gaye.

causes.en: Cold weather raised Voc above the device maximum.
causes.ur: Sardi mein Voc device ke maximum se upar chala gaya.

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch immediately and do not reconnect until the array voltage is confirmed below the rated maximum.
solutions.ur: Foran DC switch disconnect karein aur array ka voltage rated maximum se neeche confirm hone tak dobara na jodein.

solutions.en: Measure the string open-circuit voltage with a meter and count the panels in series against the device rating.
solutions.ur: Meter se string ka open-circuit voltage naapein aur series mein panels ki tadad device rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: Remove panels from the string to bring the voltage down, then reconnect; if the message remains, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Voltage kam karne ke liye string se panels hatayein, phir jodein; message bana rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

notes.en: Immediate disconnect instruction -> danger severity. Numeric warning stored W-prefixed to avoid collision with same-number fault in this series file.
notes.ur: Foran disconnect karne ka instruction diya gaya hai -> danger severity. Yeh numeric warning W-prefix ke sath store ki gayi hai taake isi file mein same number ke fault se takraw na ho.

solutions.en: Disconnect any load on battery immediately and confirm voltage; after normal if message remains contact manufacturer
solutions.ur: Battery se koi bhi load foran hatayein aur voltage confirm karein; voltage normal hone ke baad bhi message rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.
